query: What procedures and budgets should we use to obtain and validate ground-truth fault and RUL labels (sensor-sourced labels, expert review, inter-labeler agreement metrics, human-labeling budgets)?

response.query: What procedures and budgets should we use to obtain and validate ground-truth fault and RUL labels (sensor-sourced labels, expert review, inter-labeler agreement metrics, human-labeling budgets)?
response.answer: To obtain and validate fault and RUL labels, use expert review and inter-labeler agreement metrics. Budget for human labeling and consider AI-assisted annotation for efficiency. Ensure rigorous validation processes to maintain label accuracy.

results.title: Transforming Data Annotation with AI Agents: A Review of Architectures, Reasoning, Applications, and Impact
results.content: These developments are expected to transform the future landscape of data annotation systems, wherein AI agents will continuously learn and improve their annotation tasks through dynamic collaboration with both humans and other agents [[17](https://www.mdpi.com/1999-5903/17/8/353#B17-futureinternet-17-00353)]. [[30](https://www.mdpi.com/1999-5903/17/8/353#B30-futureinternet-17-00353)] | Multi-role LLM agent (Plan, Tool, Reflect) with self-correction loop | Automated outcome annotation (QA extraction, slot tagging, reasoning traces) | In-context learning, chain-of-thought, feedback refinement | Human-level label quality; Decomposition-based auditable labels |. [[93](https://www.mdpi.com/1999-5903/17/8/353#B93-futureinternet-17-00353)] | Single large-model agent with modular subsystems (Task Setting / Planning / Capability / Memory + Reflection) | Signal-analysis annotation: pre-processing, reasoning and planning, tool invocation, memory and reflection | Internal memory, self-questioning reflection, external tool calls (Matlab, RAG), multi-agent interaction bus | Autonomy, tool-use, continuous self-improvement, multimodal reasoning | Domain-specific (ETAR); relies on external tools and prompt engineering | Industrial / defense analytics needing rigorous, auditable annotation of complex sensor data |. [](mailto:?&subject=From%20MDPI%3A%20%22Transforming%20Data%20Annotation%20with%20AI%20Agents%3A%20A%20Review%20of%20Architectures%2C%20Reasoning%2C%20Applications%2C%20and%20Impact%22&body=https://www.mdpi.com/3432752%3A%0A%0ATransforming%20Data%20Annotation%20with%20AI%20Agents%3A%20A%20Review%20of%20Architectures%2C%20Reasoning%2C%20Applications%2C%20and%20Impact%0A%0AAbstract%3A%20Data%20annotation%20serves%20as%20a%20critical%20foundation%20for%20artificial%20intelligence%20%28AI%29%20and%20machine%20learning%20%28ML%29.%20Recently%2C%20AI%20agents%20powered%20by%20large%20language%20models%20%28LLMs%29%20have%20emerged%20as%20effective%20solutions%20to%20longstanding%20challenges%20in%20data%20annotation%2C%20such%20as%20scalability%2C%20consistency%2C%20cost%2C%20and%20limitations%20in%20domain%20expertise.%20These%20agents%20facilitate%20intelligent%20automation%20and%20adaptive%20decision-making%2C%20thereby%20enhancing%20the%20efficiency%20and%20reliability%20of%20annotation%20workflows%20across%20various%20fields.%20Despite%20the%20growing%20interest%20in%20this%20area%2C%20a%20systematic%20understanding%20of%20the%20role%20and%20capabilities%20of%20AI%20agents%20in%20annotation%20is%20still%20underexplored.%20This%20paper%20seeks%20to%20fill%20that%20gap%20by%20providing%20a%20comprehensive%20review%20of%20how%20LLM-driven%20agents%20support%20advanced%20reasoning%20strategies%2C%20adaptive%20learning%2C%20and%20collaborative%20annotation%20efforts.%20We%20analyze%20agent%20architectures%2C%20integration%20patterns%20within%20workflows%2C%20and%20evaluation%20methods%2C%20along%20with%20real-world%20applications%20in%20sectors%20such%20as%20healthcare%2C%20finance%2C%20technology%2C%20and%20media.%20Furthermore%2C%20we%20evaluate%20current%20tools%20and%20platforms%20that%20support%20agent-based%20annotation%2C%20addressing%20key%20challenges%20such%20as%20quality%20assurance%2C%20bias%20mitigation%2C[...]
